concepts.name: Fundamentals Of Programming 6.1 Unit Ove
concepts.simple_definition: 204 Unit 6 : Fundamentals of Programming 6.1 Unit Overview As it was defined and discussed in grade 9, problem-solving steps are used to solve day-to-day problems and make strategies to handle different situations which keep arising in day-to-day life
concepts.deep_explanation: One method of solving problems in computer science is using algorithms
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Fundamentals of Programming 6.1 Unit Ove from page 211.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Fundamentals of Programming 6.1 Unit Ove with adjacent topics in Chapter 6.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 204 Unit 6 : Fundamentals of Programming 6.1 Unit Overview As it was defined and discussed in grade 9, problem-solving steps are used to solve day-to-day problems and make strategies to handle different situations which keep arising in day-to-day life (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] One method of solving problems in computer science is using algorithms — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 211 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።

concepts.name: Grade 10 Information Technology Student’
concepts.simple_definition: Grade 10 Information Technology Student’s Textbook 207 Figure 6.2 Description of the algorithm Before a computer can be put to any meaningful use, the user must be able to define a unit sequence of operations or activities which are logically ordered as an unambiguous method of solving a problem or finding a solution to it, which is termed as an algorithm
concepts.deep_explanation: The term algorithm means “a process or set of rules to be followed in calculations or other problem-solving operations”
